# BD7 — Environment Runbook

**Solution:** KSE Memory SDK v3 — Universal Hybrid Knowledge Substrate (SOL-01)

## Environments

| Env | Purpose | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Local dev | Full substrate, CPU-only | Python >=3.9 venv; `pip install -e .[dev]`; no API key needed (AR-01) |
| CI (GitHub-hosted) | Tests + CPU benchmarks | ubuntu-latest CPU runners; no GPU (D-03); reduced BEIR subsets pinned in benchmarks/ |
| PyPI release | Distribution | Trusted publishing via GitHub OIDC — no long-lived PyPI token |

## SLO verification

- p95 hybrid query <150ms @100k items CPU-only (D-10 — confirm): latency regression test per release
- Embedding throughput >=500 items/min single-core (ONNX int8)
- `pip install` on CPU-only image must succeed with zero NVIDIA packages (AR-04, CI-asserted)

## Secrets & Credentials

| Secret | Needed for | Dev | CI | Prod/user |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAI API key | OPTIONAL dimension scoring only | `.env.local` (never commit) | Not required — CI uses local scorer | User-supplied env var; never stored by SDK |
| Graph backend creds (Neo4j etc.) | Tier 1/2 integration tests | `.env.local` | GitHub Actions secrets, scoped to integration job | User config; passed through, never persisted |
| PyPI publish | Releases | — | GitHub OIDC trusted publishing (no static credential) | — |

Rotation: backend test credentials rotate quarterly; no other long-lived secrets exist by design (GOV-02).

## Default-path guarantees (enforced)

- Zero network calls, no API key, no CUDA (AR-01, AR-04, GOV-02, GOV-03)
- Telemetry only after explicit opt-in consent (D-02)
- Simulations never importable from benchmarks (AR-02)
